_comment: ENTRY shape, calibrated specifically for T (T-Bank) — this grid is wider than the root data/params/rsi_pullback/cal_entry.json. Sweeps the RSI length and the lower band whose DOWNWARD cross opens the trade, together with the exit band RSIUpper (120 evaluations). A shorter period dips under the band more often, so signals get more numerous and noisier; a lower band demands a deeper spike, so signals get rarer and more extreme. This is the signal generator itself — run it even when the screen says the filters are dead. Everything else inherits DefaultParams. Run: go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker T -strategy rsi_pullback -interval Minutes30 -calibrate data/params/rsi_pullback/t/cal_entry.json -out ./reports/T_entry -months 24 -min-trades 20 -test-months 6 -metric profit_factor.
